predecessors.text: the Northern Province, the former Northern Nigeria Protectorate

predecessors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
predecessors.text: the Colony of Southern Nigeria (Lagos Colony and the Southern Nigeria Protectorate merged in 1906)

successors.name: Federal Republic of Nigeria
successors.text: the Colony and Protectorate: Lagos, Southern Nigeria and Northern Nigeria amalgamated

ledger.x: 1914 (1 January): the Colony and Protectorate of Nigeria is formed.
1914 (1 January): the Northern Province, the Colony and the Southern Provinces are unified.
1916 (20 July): Britain and France divide German Kamerun.
1922: the British share becomes a League of Nations mandate.
1922: the Cameroons are administered with Nigeria.
1960 (1 October): Nigeria becomes independent while the Cameroons stay a UN trust territory.

wars.name: Kamerun campaign
wars.outcome: Allied victory: Kamerun partitioned between Britain and France on 20 July 1916, the British taking the smaller share.

certainty.note: The frontiers with Dahomey, Niger, Chad and Kamerun were fixed by Anglo-French and Anglo-German agreements that no page opened gives; the Lake Chad and Bakassi sectors stayed disputed ('governed by Nigeria until 2008').
